not_changed.finding: 3 Taint: Telepathy duration hard-coded 5 while text shows data.dur
not_changed.evidence: core pinned 624a6732 game/modules/tome/data/talents/misc/inscriptions.lua:1203-1210 action: takeHit(max_life*0.2), setEffect(EFF_SENSE, 5, {range=getTalentRange (10), actor=1}), setEffect(EFF_WEAKENED_MIND, 10, {save=10, power=35}); info :1212-1215 passes data.dur as first %d. WEAKENED_MIND (timed_effects/mental.lua:1563-1577) does -10 mind save, +35 mindpower: matches.
not_changed.notes: Error is in the placeholder argument (data.dur, never used by the action). Could only be fixed by dropping/repurposing the first %d. No core item or DLC grants this taint (git grep TAINT_TELEPATHY: none outside locales/talent definition), so data.dur is unverifiable and the talent is effectively unreachable. Advisory.

not_changed.evidence: Orcs DLC unpinned. tome-orcs/data/talents/misc/npcs.lua:30-35 radius=scale(3,8) but target {type='cone', radius=getTalentRange(t)} with range=0 -> cone radius 0. The main claim (it applies STUNNED, not stoning; lines 2-4 describe nothing real) is still unfixed at tome-orcs.lua:4029 (current text still says 石化) because the 30%% literal must be kept - that remains a caller decision.
